propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently lives only in a non-gating inline step in prompt-eval.yml workflow and does not block Gerrit Verified vote.
Three plan-review specs (asserted-capability, decomp-shape, necessity) shipped with dataset but no gold_set, merged green despite prompt-eval workflow being red.
No unit test in the default pytest suite covers glob-based validation of all packaged eval specs; existing test_new_eval_specs.py only checks a hardcoded 3-spec tuple.
A unit test must be added to tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py that globs every packaged spec and asserts validate_eval_spec(spec) and validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) for dataset-bearing specs.
The redundant inline validation step must be removed from .github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml after moving the check into the gating default test suite.
